title: The Philosophy of Freedom
author: rudolf-steiner
attributionNote: Written by Rudolf Steiner before the development of Anthroposophy as a movement. It is a philosophical work, not an Anthroposophical scripture.
description: Steiner’s inquiry into knowledge, freedom and ethical individualism. It argues for a form of intuitive thinking as the basis of free action.
historicalContext: Published in 1894 while Steiner was working within German philosophical and Goethean traditions. Its relationship to his later spiritual science is itself debated.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. German original may be public domain; English translations have separate rights. No text is imported.
